  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_RoboticBurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller" processRef="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AskMenu" name="Menu or burger only?" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AskSide" name="Fries or wedges?" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdate" name="Status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller" name="Robotic Burger Seller" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" name="Ask: menu or just the burger?"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_MenuOrBurger" name="Menu or burger only?" default="Flow_BurgerOnly"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_MenuSplit" name="Start menu preparation"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask: fries or wedges?"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_MenuJoin" name="Menu side dish selected"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?" default="Flow_Wedges"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BurgerMerge" name="Ready for burger preparation"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Timer_StatusUpdate" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_StatusUpdate">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="TC_StatusUpdate">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdate" name="Send enthusiastic status update"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusSent" name="Status update sent"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DeliverViaConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAsk" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskToChoice" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gw_MenuOrBurger"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gw_MenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gw_MenuSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="CE_Menu">${orderType == 'menu'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Burger only" sourceRef="Gw_MenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gw_BurgerMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gw_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToAskSide" sourceRef="Gw_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gw_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSideToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gw_MenuJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToSideChoice" sourceRef="Gw_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gw_SideChoice"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gw_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="CE_Fries">${side == 'fries'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gw_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gw_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gw_BurgerMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToBurger" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerToDeliver" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverViaConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DeliverViaConveyor" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToStatus" sourceRef="Timer_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_AskMenuOrBurger</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_MenuOrBurger</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_MenuSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_PrepareDrink</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_AskFriesOrWedges</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_SideChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_PrepareFries</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_PrepareWedges</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_SideMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_MenuJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_BurgerMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_BurgerSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_PrepareBurger</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Timer_StatusInterval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_StatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_UpdateCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_BurgerJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_DeliverViaConveyor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderDelivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AskMenuOrBurger" name="Ask menu or burger only"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_MenuOrBurger" name="Menu or burger only?" default="Flow_BurgerOnly"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_MenuSplit" name="Start menu preparation"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask fries or wedges"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?" default="Flow_Wedges"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on fries portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on wedges portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_SideMerge" name="Side prepared"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_MenuJoin" name="Drink prepared and side prepared"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BurgerMerge" name="Ready for burger preparation"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_BurgerSplit" name="Start burger preparation"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>

      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_StatusUpdate" name="Send enthusiastic status update"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_UpdateCheck" name="Burger still in preparation?" default="Flow_UpdateDone"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_BurgerJoin" name="Burger prepared and status updates finished"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_DeliverViaConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAsk" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="UserTask_AskMenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskToChoice" sourceRef="UserTask_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gw_MenuOrBurger"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gw_MenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gw_MenuSplit">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gw_MenuSplit" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToAskSide" sourceRef="Gw_MenuSplit" targetRef="UserTask_AskFriesOrWedges"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSideToChoice" sourceRef="UserTask_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gw_SideChoice"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gw_SideChoice" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="CE_Fries">${side == 'fries'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gw_SideChoice" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareWedges"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesToSideMerge" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gw_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesToSideMerge" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gw_SideMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gw_SideMerge" targetRef="Gw_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToJoin" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gw_MenuJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoinToBurgerMerge" sourceRef="Gw_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gw_BurgerMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToBurgerSplit" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Gw_BurgerSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPrepareBurger" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerSplit" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToTimer" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerSplit" targetRef="Timer_StatusInterval"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToStatus" sourceRef="Timer_StatusInterval" targetRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gw_UpdateCheck"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLoop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_UpdateCheck" targetRef="Timer_StatusInterval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="CE_UpdateLoop">${burgerPreparationDone == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_UpdateCheck" targetRef="Gw_BurgerJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareBurgerToJoin" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Gw_BurgerJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToDeliver" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerJoin" targetRef="ServiceTask_DeliverViaConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverToEnd" sourceRef="ServiceTask_DeliverViaConveyor" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_BurgerJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_DeliverViaConveyor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderDelivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AskMenuOrBurger" name="Ask menu or burger only"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_MenuOrBurger" name="Menu or burger only?" default="Flow_BurgerOnly"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_MenuSplit" name="Start drink preparation and side question"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask fries or wedges"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?" default="Flow_Wedges"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on fries portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on wedges portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_SideMerge" name="Side prepared"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_MenuJoin" name="Drink prepared and side prepared"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BurgerMerge" name="Ready for burger preparation"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_BurgerSplit" name="Start burger preparation"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_StatusInterval" name="Every 30 seconds">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_StatusInterval">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="TD_30Seconds">PT30S</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_StatusUpdate" name="Send enthusiastic status update"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_UpdateCheck" name="Burger still in preparation?" default="Flow_UpdateDone"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_BurgerJoin" name="Burger prepared and status updates finished"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_DeliverViaConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAsk" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="UserTask_AskMenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskToChoice" sourceRef="UserTask_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gw_MenuOrBurger"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gw_MenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gw_MenuSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="CE_Menu">${orderType == 'menu'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Burger only" sourceRef="Gw_MenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gw_BurgerMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gw_MenuSplit" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToAskSide" sourceRef="Gw_MenuSplit" targetRef="UserTask_AskFriesOrWedges"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSideToChoice" sourceRef="UserTask_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gw_SideChoice"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gw_SideChoice" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="CE_Fries">${side == 'fries'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gw_SideChoice" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareWedges"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesToSideMerge" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gw_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesToSideMerge" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gw_SideMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gw_SideMerge" targetRef="Gw_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToJoin" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gw_MenuJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoinToBurgerMerge" sourceRef="Gw_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gw_BurgerMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToBurgerSplit" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Gw_BurgerSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPrepareBurger" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerSplit" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToTimer" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerSplit" targetRef="Timer_StatusInterval"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToStatus" sourceRef="Timer_StatusInterval" targetRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToCheck" sourceRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gw_UpdateCheck"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLoop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_UpdateCheck" targetRef="Timer_StatusInterval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="CE_UpdateLoop">${burgerPreparationDone == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_UpdateCheck" targetRef="Gw_BurgerJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareBurgerToJoin" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Gw_BurgerJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToDeliver" sourceRef="Gw_BurgerJoin" targetRef="ServiceTask_DeliverViaConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverToEnd" sourceRef="ServiceTask_DeliverViaConveyor" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description has the process ask a participant a question that offers alternatives (X or Y), and the steps that follow depend on the answer: Model an exclusive gateway directly after the activity that poses the question, with one outgoing sequence flow per possible answer. Each flow leads to its own path, and the alternative paths reconverge at an exclusive merge before the next common step. Do not connect the question activity straight to a single continuation when the answer selects between paths.
rules.situation: the description has the process ask a participant a question that offers alternatives (X or Y), and the steps that follow depend on the answer

rules.instruction: When the description says the process poses a question to the customer that offers alternatives while another activity is already running (for example 'while doing so'), and no message to a separate participant is stated for that question: Model the question as a user task in the lane of the actor the description names, labelled with the question's verb and main object, not as a send task. Open it as a branch that runs in parallel with the ongoing activity, so the two are joined by a parallel gateway. Place an exclusive gateway after the question with one outgoing flow per possible answer, each leading to its own path.
rules.situation: the description says the process poses a question to the customer that offers alternatives while another activity is already running (for example 'while doing so'), and no message to a separate participant is stated for that question

rules.instruction: When the description says that the process repeatedly sends informational updates to a participant while a work step is in progress, and the sending of each update is the modeled work of the process: Model each repeated update as a send task (bpmn:sendTask), not as a service task, and keep the sending verb from the description in its label. Place it in a parallel branch that runs alongside the work step it reports on, and synchronize it with a parallel join. Do not give a message-sending activity the type of an automated service call.
rules.situation: the description says that the process repeatedly sends informational updates to a participant while a work step is in progress, and the sending of each update is the modeled work of the process

rules.instruction: When the description says the process asks the customer a question that offers alternatives (for example, a menu or just the item, or a choice of side), and the customer's answer decides which branch follows: Model the question as a single user task in which the customer makes the choice, placed at the point in the sequence where the description states it. Follow it with an exclusive gateway that has one outgoing flow per stated alternative. Do not model the same question as a separate ask task alongside the choice task, and do not place the choice after the branch it decides.
rules.situation: the description says the process asks the customer a question that offers alternatives (for example, a menu or just the item, or a choice of side), and the customer's answer decides which branch follows
